name: Quick N Tasty (Garden City, UT) Charbroiled Plain Cheeseburger & Fries
brandOrRestaurant: Quick N Tasty (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Classic Bear Lake roadside drive-in. High-heat charbroiled beef patty on a soft toasted bun with American cheese and ketchup. Easy to tolerate in remission when ordered plain.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold onions, pickles, and lettuce).
